summary: Phase 1 smoke test of Cloud Student Portal (Flask + Jinja + MongoDB). Backend health, landing page, auth flows (register validation, duplicate email, invalid + valid login), dashboard access control, session persistence, and logout all verified end-to-end. 20/20 UI checks + 3/3 backend smoke checks passed. test_credentials.md is empty — used credentials from review request (ibrahim@cloud.com / admin123).
passed: GET / -> 200 with navbar (brand-link, nav-login, nav-register) and hero CTAs (hero-cta-register, hero-cta-login) visible
GET /dashboard unauthenticated -> 302 to /login with warning flash 'Please log in to continue.'
Invalid login flashes 'Invalid email or password.'
Registration validation: invalid email + short password + mismatched confirm produces 3 danger flashes
Registration success: unique email creates account, redirects to /login with success flash 'Account created — you can log in now.'
Duplicate email registration blocked with 'An account with this email already exists.'
Seeded admin login (ibrahim@cloud.com/admin123) redirects to /dashboard with 'Welcome back, Ibrahim (Admin)!' flash
Dashboard renders dashboard-title, stat-users, stat-students, stat-courses, stat-status, activity-panel, quick-panel
Logout clears session, flashes 'You have been logged out.', redirects to /; subsequent /dashboard redirects back to /login
action_items: Optional: populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the seeded admin credentials so future test agents don't have to rely on the review request.
test_credentials_note: /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but is empty. Used ibrahim@cloud.com / admin123 from the review request; login worked, confirming the idempotent seed on startup.
